notes: Shutter works on a HERO9 that 404s the Open GoPro shutter path: the app now falls back to the legacy shutter command instead of failing every capture. The calibration clip is no longer analysed as a golf shot. From 0.1.6: calibration reports why the shutter failed, confirms the camera is recording, live view cannot block the shutter, and status says when there is no media list (SD card out).
